verdict.rationale: Kommo is a SaaS CRM, so letting customers choose a data-storage region is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions data residency, hosting regions, or region selection. The cited items cover integrations, the API, webhooks, pricing and marketing claims, none of which address where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
